about: Links the introducing paper itself prints in its front matter ("Code — URL", "Datasets — URL") that were NOT confirmed as a benchmark's location in the individual review (2026-10-20/21). Each link belongs to the paper that printed it (paper_id); `line` is that paper's verbatim text; `observed` is what was seen at the URL on that date, nothing more; `reviews` says per benchmark why it is not a confirmed location. Never promoted to config/introduced_locations.json without a new review. `source.archive_sha256` is the decompressed archived HTML the line was read from: the build drops a link whose archive has changed until it is reviewed again.
